def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

open(P+'/lib.py','w').write('''from collections import Counter

def bounding_box(cells):
    """(min_row, min_col, max_row, max_col) of a list of (row, col) cells."""
    rs = [i for i, _ in cells]; cs = [j for _, j in cells]
    return min(rs), min(cs), max(rs), max(cs)

def full_lines(grid, color):
    """([row indices that are entirely color], [column indices that are entirely color])."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [i for i in range(h) if all(v == color for v in grid[i])]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == color for i in range(h))]
    return rows, cols

def background(grid):
    """The most common color in the grid."""
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

def shift_cells(grid, cells, drow, dcol, bg):
    """Move the given cells by (drow, dcol), leaving background color behind."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for i, j in cells: out[i][j] = bg
    for i, j in cells: out[i + drow][j + dcol] = grid[i][j]
    return out

def sandwich_line(grid, color=8):
    """Translate the non-background object until it touches the full line of color 2,
    then draw a full line of the given color on the object's opposite side."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = background(grid)
    lrows, lcols = full_lines(grid, 2)
    cells = [(i, j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j] not in (bg, 2)]
    if lcols:
        lc = lcols[0]
        _, mn, _, mx = bounding_box(cells)
        out = shift_cells(grid, cells, 0, lc - 1 - mx, bg)
        for i in range(h): out[i][mn + lc - 1 - mx - 1] = color
    else:
        lr = lrows[0]
        mn, _, mx, _ = bounding_box(cells)
        out = shift_cells(grid, cells, lr - 1 - mx, 0, bg)
        for j in range(w): out[mn + lr - 1 - mx - 1][j] = color
    return out
''')
